prompt:

Asset type: dental clinic service card, one individual square editorial photograph, 1536x1536 pixels or at least 1024x1024 native generation.

Materials/textures: delicate natural enamel texture and subtle translucency, matte soft gum material, fine polished metal details and soft tiny brush bristles, lightly porous stone.
Color palette: warm ivory, cream, beige, subdued apricot pink, natural steel.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no labels, no packaging, no extra teeth floating, no graphical overlays; one image only. New detailed native-resolution generation, not an upscale or crop.
